## 任务：文献搜索 — 训练 loss 改善但下游 eval 恶化的现象

### 背景
我们的实验发现一个重要 pattern：error injection（无论 TaxEI 还是 Random）使得训练 loss 更低、token accuracy 更高，但下游 clean eval 性能反而下降。具体数据：

| Experiment | Final Loss | Final Acc | Eval (47 tasks) |
|---|---|---|---|
| vanilla 0% | 0.2937 | 0.8936 | 61.7% |
| random 10% | 0.2907 | 0.8959 | 68.1% |
| random 25% | 0.2635 | 0.9074 | 待测 |
| random 50% | 0.2600 | 0.9076 | 待测 |
| taxei 50% | 0.2601 | 0.9088 | 51.1% |

50% injection：训练 loss 最低但 eval 最差（taxei 51.1%）。

### 搜索方向
1. **Training-eval mismatch / distribution shift**: 模型 overfit 到 injected data 的分布，clean eval 是 OOD
2. **Noise memorization**: 类似 label noise 中 DNN 先学 pattern 再 memorize noise 的 "early learning" phenomenon (Arpit et al. 2017)
3. **Data augmentation 失效场景**: NLP/agent 领域 data augmentation 反而降低性能的案例
4. **训练指标与下游任务脱钩**: 尤其是 SFT 场景下 loss/perplexity 不等于 task performance

### 产出
搜索 3-5 篇最相关的论文，每篇写：
- 标题、作者、年份、venue
- 与我们发现的关联点
- 可引用的核心结论

写入项目文件 memory.md 的"文献调研关键洞察"部分不需要，直接输出结果即可。我会后续整合。

# Literature Map: Dose-Response / Threshold Effects in Data Augmentation
# Updated: 2026-05-15

entries:
  # === Category: dose-response / threshold ===

  - id: rolnick2017robust
    title: "Deep Learning is Robust to Massive Label Noise"
    authors: "Rolnick, Veit, Belongie, Shavit"
    year: 2017
    venue: arXiv 1705.10694
    category: dose-response
    role: background
    key_finding: "DNNs maintain >90% accuracy on MNIST even when correct labels are diluted 100:1, as long as correct label remains most likely by a small margin."
    relevance: "Contrasts with our finding: image classification is robust to extreme noise, while embodied planning shows sharp degradation at 25%. Task complexity mediates noise tolerance."

  - id: li2024early_stopping
    title: "Early Stopping Against Label Noise Without Validation Data"
    authors: "Li et al."
    year: 2024
    venue: ICLR 2024
    category: dose-response
    role: background
    key_finding: "Identifies phase transition where DNNs shift from fitting clean to fitting mislabeled examples. Proposes Label Wave to detect this transition during training."
    relevance: "Supports existence of phase transition in learning dynamics. Our 10-25% threshold may correspond to such a transition point in the SFT regime."

  - id: dohmatob2025collapse
    title: "Strong Model Collapse"
    authors: "Dohmatob, Feng"
    year: 2025
    venue: ICLR 2025
    category: threshold
    role: background
    key_finding: "Even 0.1% synthetic data can cause model collapse in supervised regression. Past interpolation threshold, larger models become more robust (double-descent)."
    relevance: "Demonstrates extreme sensitivity to data quality in certain regimes. Our 10-25% threshold is analogous—small quality shifts cause nonlinear degradation."

  - id: beyond_clean_data2024
    title: "Beyond Clean Data: Exploring the Effects of Label Noise on Object Detection Performance"
    authors: "Various"
    year: 2024
    venue: ScienceDirect
    category: dose-response
    role: background
    key_finding: "Systematically varies noise levels in training and validation for object detection, mapping convergence limits and degradation thresholds."
    relevance: "Methodologically similar—varies noise proportion to find degradation curves. Shows task-specific threshold behavior."

  # === Category: error-injection / failure augmentation ===

  - id: wang2024learning_from_failure
    title: "Learning From Failure: Integrating Negative Examples when Fine-tuning Large Language Models as Agents"
    authors: "Wang, Li, Han, Zhang, Baldwin"
    year: 2024
    venue: arXiv 2402.11651
    category: error-injection
    role: evaluation
    key_finding: "Failed trajectories provide valuable signal for LLM agents via contrastive learning. Negative examples improve math, QA, strategic tasks when properly structured."
    relevance: "Directly related—injects negative trajectories into agent SFT. Key difference: they use contrastive framing, not raw mixing. Our work shows raw mixing has narrow safe window."

  - id: song2024eto
    title: "Trial and Error: Exploration-Based Trajectory Optimization for LLM Agents"
    authors: "Song, Yin, Yue, Huang, Li, Lin"
    year: 2024
    venue: ACL 2024
    category: error-injection
    role: evaluation
    key_finding: "Iteratively collects failure trajectories, uses DPO-style contrastive learning on success-failure pairs. +8% WebShop, +9.5% ScienceWorld vs SFT."
    relevance: "Uses failure trajectories via preference optimization (DPO), not direct SFT mixing. Avoids our threshold problem by never training directly on failures."

  - id: paladin2025
    title: "PALADIN: Self-Correcting Language Model Agents to Cure Tool-Failure Cases"
    authors: "Vuddanti, Shah et al."
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2509.25238
    category: error-injection
    role: evaluation
    key_finding: "Trains on 50K+ recovery-annotated failure trajectories via LoRA. +13.6% recovery rate, +10.2% task success. Taxonomy of 7 error classes."
    relevance: "Most similar to our approach (taxonomy-guided error injection). Key difference: they pair failures with recovery demos; we inject standalone error trajectories."

  - id: agentHER2025
    title: "AgentHER: Hindsight Experience Replay for LLM Agent Trajectory Relabeling"
    authors: "Various"
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2603.21357
    category: error-injection
    role: evaluation
    key_finding: "Converts failed trajectories to valid training data by relabeling—failure for task A becomes success for task B."
    relevance: "Avoids noise problem by redefining failure as success for different goals. Contrasts with our direct injection approach."

  # === Category: data-mixing ===

  - id: dong2024composition
    title: "How Abilities in Large Language Models are Affected by Supervised Fine-tuning Data Composition"
    authors: "Dong, Yuan et al."
    year: 2024
    venue: ACL 2024
    category: data-mixing
    role: background
    key_finding: "Data amount per domain matters more than ratio. Low-data mixing enables cross-domain transfer; high-data mixing causes ability conflicts."
    relevance: "Documents ability-conflict at high data amounts—analogous to our threshold. Ratio secondary to amount suggests our threshold may be absolute-count driven."

  - id: ye2025mixing_laws
    title: "Data Mixing Laws: Optimizing Data Mixtures by Predicting Language Modeling Performance"
    authors: "Ye et al."
    year: 2025
    venue: ICLR 2025
    category: data-mixing
    role: background
    key_finding: "Discovers quantitative scaling laws L=f(r) for mixture proportions. Accurately predicts critical proportion avoiding catastrophic forgetting."
    relevance: "Their 'critical proportion for catastrophic forgetting' is conceptually identical to our threshold—both mark a phase transition in mixing."

  - id: li2025mixing_optimization
    title: "Data Mixing Optimization for Supervised Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models"
    authors: "Li et al."
    year: 2025
    venue: ICML 2025
    category: data-mixing
    role: background
    key_finding: "SFT mixing as optimization with scaling-law parameterization. Optimal weights depend on model size and data scale."
    relevance: "Optimal mixing is model-size dependent—our 7B model may have different threshold than larger models. Finding is scale-specific."

  - id: seddik2024synthetic_bound
    title: "Upper Bounds on Synthetic Data Proportion to Avoid Model Collapse"
    authors: "Seddik et al."
    year: 2024
    venue: arXiv
    category: data-mixing
    role: background
    key_finding: "Theoretical upper bounds on low-quality data proportion before collapse. Real data proportion must remain high."
    relevance: "Theoretical grounding for hard thresholds in quality mixing. Our empirical 10-25% window is consistent with their predictions."

  # === Category: curriculum / quality threshold ===

  - id: curriculum_robust2024
    title: "Robust Curriculum Learning: from Clean Label Detection to Noisy Label Self-Correction"
    authors: "Various"
    year: 2024
    venue: OpenReview
    category: curriculum
    role: background
    key_finding: "Networks learn simple patterns first, then overfit noisy labels. Loss-based curriculum selection is unstable; errors accumulate multiplicatively."
    relevance: "Explains WHY threshold exists: once noisy proportion exceeds implicit curriculum capacity, errors accumulate. Our 25% may exceed model's capacity."

  - id: wkm2024alfworld
    title: "Agent Planning with World Knowledge Model"
    authors: "Various"
    year: 2024
    venue: NeurIPS 2024
    category: curriculum
    role: evaluation
    key_finding: "World knowledge models reduce hallucinatory actions in ALFWorld. SFT on expert trajectories prone to overfitting."
    relevance: "ALFWorld baseline showing SFT quality sensitivity. Hallucination increase from poor training data parallels our error-injection degradation."

  # === Category: training-dynamics / memorization ===

  - id: arpit2017memorization
    title: "A Closer Look at Memorization in Deep Networks"
    authors: "Arpit, Jastrzębski, Ballas, Krueger, Bengio, Kanwal, Maharaj, Fischer, Courville, Bengio, Lacoste-Julien"
    year: 2017
    venue: ICML 2017
    category: training-dynamics
    role: background
    key_finding: "DNNs first learn clean patterns (early learning phase), then memorize noise. Training loss/accuracy improve on noisy data but generalization degrades. Dataset-independent capacity concepts are insufficient."
    relevance: "Directly explains our '50% injection → lowest train loss but worst eval' paradox. Higher injection = more noisy samples to memorize, better train metrics but worse generalization."

  - id: liu2020early_learning_reg
    title: "Early-Learning Regularization Prevents Memorization of Noisy Labels"
    authors: "Liu, Niles-Weed, Razavian, Fernandez-Granda"
    year: 2020
    venue: NeurIPS 2020
    category: training-dynamics
    role: background
    key_finding: "Formalizes early learning phenomenon: models predict true labels for mislabeled examples early in training, then memorize wrong labels. ELR regularization exploits this window."
    relevance: "Our error-injected samples may be correctly handled early in training but memorized later, degrading clean-data generalization. Explains why more epochs could worsen the gap."

  - id: zhou2023lima
    title: "LIMA: Less Is More for Alignment"
    authors: "Zhou, Liu, Xu, Iyer, Sun, Du, Lin, Geng, Zhang, Patel, Yu, Hinton"
    year: 2023
    venue: NeurIPS 2023
    category: training-dynamics
    role: background
    key_finding: "Superficial Alignment Hypothesis: LLM knowledge/capability comes from pretraining; SFT only teaches output style/format. Limited SFT data suffices."
    relevance: "Explains why lower SFT loss ≠ better downstream capability. Error injection improves surface-level fitting (lower loss) but doesn't enhance—and may damage—pretrained planning capability."

  - id: luo2023catastrophic_forgetting
    title: "An Empirical Study of Catastrophic Forgetting in Large Language Models During Continual Fine-tuning"
    authors: "Luo, Xu, Zheng, Zhao, Yang, Bian, Zheng"
    year: 2023
    venue: arXiv 2308.08747
    category: training-dynamics
    role: background
    key_finding: "SFT is off-policy learning prone to overfit training distribution and forget pretraining knowledge. Forgetting severity increases with divergence between fine-tuning and pretraining distributions."
    relevance: "Error injection increases distributional gap from pretraining data, accelerating catastrophic forgetting. 50% injection → maximal divergence → most forgetting of planning capability."

  - id: longpre2020augmentation
    title: "To Augment or Not to Augment? A Comparative Study on Text Augmentation Techniques for Low-Resource NLP"
    authors: "Longpre, Wang, De Melo"
    year: 2020
    venue: ACL (Computational Linguistics)
    category: training-dynamics
    role: background
    key_finding: "Text augmentation methods assume label-preservation and distribution-stationarity; violations degrade performance. Token-level augmentation surprisingly hurts on complex tasks."
    relevance: "Error injection is non-label-preserving augmentation that shifts distribution. Explains why Random 10% (mild shift, preserves diversity) helps but higher ratios (major shift) hurt."

## 关键发现

- **v4 正式判定: Gate 3a FAIL, Gate 3b FAIL**: TaxEI 61.7% = vanilla 61.7%, random 66.0% 反超。Taxonomy 标签在 clean-task eval 上无额外价值。所有 McNemar 检验无显著性（n=47, discordant=10）。
- **Recovery eval 同样 FAIL**: TaxEI 59.6% ≤ Vanilla 61.7%，head-to-head gained 4 lost 5 net -1。Taxonomy 标签在 recovery 场景也无系统性优势。
- **Detection rate 全 0%**: 所有模型（vanilla/taxei/random）detection_rate=0。当前 eval 框架只检查最终任务成功，没有机制捕捉"模型是否意识到错误发生"。Detection 指标在当前框架下无意义——这是 eval 设计局限，不是模型能力结论。

- **TaxEI 训练方差 3.3× vanilla** (SD=10.5pp vs 3.2pp): 注入导致训练极不稳定。这本身就是 negative finding——即使平均效果为零，高方差也意味着不可靠。

- **统计功效严重不足**: n=47 的 McNemar 需要 ~17pp 才有 power，而观察效应 (11pp 均值差) 与跨 seed 噪声 (10-15pp) 在同一量级。补充实验需要更多 seed 或更大 eval set。
- **TaxEI pick_two_obj 严重退化**: 28.6% vs vanilla/random 57.1%，完全抵消其他维度的微弱优势。
- **v3 vs v4 趋势不一致**: v3 vanilla>taxei>random, v4 random>taxei=vanilla。说明 v3 数据不平衡确实是混淆变量。
- **格式对齐修复有效**: v3-vanilla SFT 74.5% vs baseline 42.6%，+31.9pp。v1 的 14.9% 崩溃是训练/eval 格式不匹配。
- **GPT-5.2 ALFWorld 成功率 ~70%** (501/714)。
- **TaxEI v1 的"保护效应"是假象**: build_recovery_prompt() 恰好用了类似 eval 的格式。
- **[2026-05-15] permutation test bug 修复后所有比较不显著**: `multiseed_stats.py` 有浮点精度 bug（`mean(a)-mean(b)` vs `mean(a-b)` 差 ~1e-17，边界情况导致 p=0）。修复后 TaxEI vs Vanilla pooled p=0.017→**0.054 (NS)**，TaxEI vs Random p=0.051→0.170 (NS)。paper_framing 中 "p=0.03" 需更正。Narrative 应从 "significant degradation" 改为 "directional but not statistically significant"。修复方法: (1) `diff_obs` 改用 `np.mean(diffs)` 统一计算路径 (2) p 值改 `(count+1)/(n_perm+1)` 避免 p=0（Phipson & Smyth 2010）。
- **[2026-05-15] Random 3-seed 完整: 63.1% ± 6.8pp**: seed=42 66.0%, seed=0 55.3%, seed=123 68.1%。排序: Vanilla (65.3%) > Random (63.1%) > TaxEI (56.7%)，但所有 pairwise 均不显著。
- **[2026-05-15] Dose-response baseline 修正**: 所有 dose-response 实验 seed=42，应对比 vanilla seed=42 (61.7%) 非 3-seed 均值 (65.3%)。修正后: 10% injection → 0pp（非 -3.6pp），25% injection → -12.8pp（非 -16.4pp）。
- **[2026-05-15] TaxEI dose-response 呈阈值效应**: 0%→61.7%, 10%→61.7%(0pp), 25%→48.9%(-12.8pp), 50%→51.1%(-10.6pp)。25% 最差而非 50%。曲线在 ~15-20% 处存在 critical threshold——低于阈值无影响，高于阈值产生退化但不再持续恶化（plateau）。之前 R²=0.961 的线性拟合是两点假象。与 noise-ratio threshold 理论 (Rolnick 2017, Ye et al. ICLR 2025) 一致。
- **[2026-05-15] Random 10% 注入反而提升性能 (+6.4pp)**: Random 10% = 68.1% vs vanilla seed=42 61.7%。TaxEI 10% = 61.7% (0pp)。在低注入比例下，随机错误注入起到数据增强作用（增加轨迹多样性），而 taxonomy 标签限制了错误分布的多样性导致无效果。这是 TaxEI vs Random 的关键差异化证据——taxonomy 标签不仅无益，在低比例时还不如随机注入。
- **[2026-05-15] Training dynamics 悖论: 注入改善训练但恶化 eval**: 50% injection (taxei/random) final loss 0.26 vs vanilla 0.29, max acc 0.93 vs 0.91——训练指标全面优于 vanilla。但 eval: taxei 50%=51.1%, vanilla=61.7%。模型 overfit 到注入数据的分布（包括错误模式），train loss 下降反映的是对这些模式的记忆，而非对 clean task 的泛化。这对 paper 重要：可以论证 injection 不是简单的"加噪声"——模型确实学到了注入内容，只是学到的内容有害。
- **[2026-05-15] Training-eval mismatch 文献解释链**: Error injection → 训练分布偏移 (Longpre 2020) → 模型先学 clean pattern 再 memorize noise (Arpit 2017, Liu 2020) → SFT loss 优化的是 surface-level 拟合而非 downstream capability (Zhou 2023 LIMA) → 偏移的训练分布加剧 catastrophic forgetting，覆写预训练知识 (Luo 2023)。Injection 比例越高，链条每个环节都放大，导致 50% injection "训练最好、eval 最差"。

## 文献调研关键洞察 (2026-05-14)

- **PALADIN 数字已验证**: 32.76% → 89.68% RR (Gemma-3-12B) 准确。但 PALADIN 不是纯 SFT — 包含 inference-time retrieval (55+ exemplars)，去掉 retrieval 后 RR 降 ~30pp。当前 paper_framing 未充分讨论此 confound。
- **PALADIN 没有多 seed 验证**: 只用 bootstrap N=1000 做统计检验，无跨 random seed variance。我们的多 seed 设计反而是方法论贡献。
- **PALADIN 用 80/20 ratio at 50K scale**: 比我们的 50/50 at 9K 更激进但规模大 5.5×。injection ratio × scale 的交互是关键未解问题。
- **ALFWorld SOTA**: CoEx 93.28% (EMNLP Findings 2025), AgentPRM 91.0% (2025), Reflexion+GPT-4 ~97% (multi-trial)。我们的 65.3% 在 SFT-only 8B 范畴合理。
- **EEF (arXiv 2504.13145) 是重要对比**: 从失败中提取好 signal 而非注入坏 signal，在 WebShop 上成功。这是关键 contrast — injection 方向可能根本错误。
- **AgentDebug (arXiv 2509.25370) 有 ALFWorld error taxonomy**: 5 维 (memory/reflection/planning/action/system)，比我们的 4 operators 更全面但方法论不同 (debugging vs augmentation)。
- **除 PALADIN 外无其他 taxonomy-guided error injection 工作** — 我们是第一个跨域迁移尝试。
- **[2026-05-15] Dose-response 文献定位**: 无先前工作报告 agent SFT 中直接错误注入的 dose-response 曲线。现有方法用 contrastive/DPO (ETO) 或配对 recovery 演示 (PALADIN)，回避了直接混入。我们的 10%→25% 阈值是该设定下首个实证锚点。
- **[2026-05-15] Training-eval mismatch 有 4 层文献支撑**: (1) memorization dynamics (Arpit 2017, Liu 2020), (2) superficial alignment hypothesis (Zhou 2023 LIMA), (3) catastrophic forgetting from distribution shift (Luo 2023), (4) augmentation failure modes (Longpre 2020)。这些论文为 negative paper Discussion 提供了强理论框架。

- **D004 RandomInjector**: 使用与 TaxEI 完全相同的 4 个算子，唯一区别是 `[Error Type: P1_xxx]` → `[Error occurred]`。
- **D005/D006 v4 同源方案**: 同一份 760 条 injected_variants 格式化两次，TaxEI=Random=9,029 samples，唯一变量是 error tag 文本。
- **D009/D010 Option C (Recovery Eval + 多种子验证)**: Gate FAIL 不可撤回。Recovery eval 是补充分析（非替代 Gate）。
- **D014 项目转向**: 全维度否定后转 negative result paper。对标 PALADIN (tool-use 正面) vs TaxEI (embodied planning 负面)。
- **核心对比维度 (negative paper)**: embodied planning (ALFWorld, long-horizon, spatial) vs tool-use (ToolBench, API call, discrete)。Error injection 可能只在 action space 离散且可枚举的场景有效。

# Literature Map: Dose-Response / Threshold Effects in Data Augmentation
# Updated: 2026-05-15

entries:
  # === Category: dose-response / threshold ===

  - id: rolnick2017robust
    title: "Deep Learning is Robust to Massive Label Noise"
    authors: "Rolnick, Veit, Belongie, Shavit"
    year: 2017
    venue: arXiv 1705.10694
    category: dose-response
    role: background
    key_finding: "DNNs maintain >90% accuracy on MNIST even when correct labels are diluted 100:1, as long as correct label remains most likely by a small margin."
    relevance: "Contrasts with our finding: image classification is robust to extreme noise, while embodied planning shows sharp degradation at 25%. Task complexity mediates noise tolerance."

  - id: li2024early_stopping
    title: "Early Stopping Against Label Noise Without Validation Data"
    authors: "Li et al."
    year: 2024
    venue: ICLR 2024
    category: dose-response
    role: background
    key_finding: "Identifies phase transition where DNNs shift from fitting clean to fitting mislabeled examples. Proposes Label Wave to detect this transition during training."
    relevance: "Supports existence of phase transition in learning dynamics. Our 10-25% threshold may correspond to such a transition point in the SFT regime."

  - id: dohmatob2025collapse
    title: "Strong Model Collapse"
    authors: "Dohmatob, Feng"
    year: 2025
    venue: ICLR 2025
    category: threshold
    role: background
    key_finding: "Even 0.1% synthetic data can cause model collapse in supervised regression. Past interpolation threshold, larger models become more robust (double-descent)."
    relevance: "Demonstrates extreme sensitivity to data quality in certain regimes. Our 10-25% threshold is analogous—small quality shifts cause nonlinear degradation."

  - id: beyond_clean_data2024
    title: "Beyond Clean Data: Exploring the Effects of Label Noise on Object Detection Performance"
    authors: "Various"
    year: 2024
    venue: ScienceDirect
    category: dose-response
    role: background
    key_finding: "Systematically varies noise levels in training and validation for object detection, mapping convergence limits and degradation thresholds."
    relevance: "Methodologically similar—varies noise proportion to find degradation curves. Shows task-specific threshold behavior."

  # === Category: error-injection / failure augmentation ===

  - id: wang2024learning_from_failure
    title: "Learning From Failure: Integrating Negative Examples when Fine-tuning Large Language Models as Agents"
    authors: "Wang, Li, Han, Zhang, Baldwin"
    year: 2024
    venue: arXiv 2402.11651
    category: error-injection
    role: evaluation
    key_finding: "Failed trajectories provide valuable signal for LLM agents via contrastive learning. Negative examples improve math, QA, strategic tasks when properly structured."
    relevance: "Directly related—injects negative trajectories into agent SFT. Key difference: they use contrastive framing, not raw mixing. Our work shows raw mixing has narrow safe window."

  - id: song2024eto
    title: "Trial and Error: Exploration-Based Trajectory Optimization for LLM Agents"
    authors: "Song, Yin, Yue, Huang, Li, Lin"
    year: 2024
    venue: ACL 2024
    category: error-injection
    role: evaluation
    key_finding: "Iteratively collects failure trajectories, uses DPO-style contrastive learning on success-failure pairs. +8% WebShop, +9.5% ScienceWorld vs SFT."
    relevance: "Uses failure trajectories via preference optimization (DPO), not direct SFT mixing. Avoids our threshold problem by never training directly on failures."

  - id: paladin2025
    title: "PALADIN: Self-Correcting Language Model Agents to Cure Tool-Failure Cases"
    authors: "Vuddanti, Shah et al."
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2509.25238
    category: error-injection
    role: evaluation
    key_finding: "Trains on 50K+ recovery-annotated failure trajectories via LoRA. +13.6% recovery rate, +10.2% task success. Taxonomy of 7 error classes."
    relevance: "Most similar to our approach (taxonomy-guided error injection). Key difference: they pair failures with recovery demos; we inject standalone error trajectories."

  - id: agentHER2025
    title: "AgentHER: Hindsight Experience Replay for LLM Agent Trajectory Relabeling"
    authors: "Various"
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2603.21357
    category: error-injection
    role: evaluation
    key_finding: "Converts failed trajectories to valid training data by relabeling—failure for task A becomes success for task B."
    relevance: "Avoids noise problem by redefining failure as success for different goals. Contrasts with our direct injection approach."

  # === Category: data-mixing ===

  - id: dong2024composition
    title: "How Abilities in Large Language Models are Affected by Supervised Fine-tuning Data Composition"
    authors: "Dong, Yuan et al."
    year: 2024
    venue: ACL 2024
    category: data-mixing
    role: background
    key_finding: "Data amount per domain matters more than ratio. Low-data mixing enables cross-domain transfer; high-data mixing causes ability conflicts."
    relevance: "Documents ability-conflict at high data amounts—analogous to our threshold. Ratio secondary to amount suggests our threshold may be absolute-count driven."

  - id: ye2025mixing_laws
    title: "Data Mixing Laws: Optimizing Data Mixtures by Predicting Language Modeling Performance"
    authors: "Ye et al."
    year: 2025
    venue: ICLR 2025
    category: data-mixing
    role: background
    key_finding: "Discovers quantitative scaling laws L=f(r) for mixture proportions. Accurately predicts critical proportion avoiding catastrophic forgetting."
    relevance: "Their 'critical proportion for catastrophic forgetting' is conceptually identical to our threshold—both mark a phase transition in mixing."

  - id: li2025mixing_optimization
    title: "Data Mixing Optimization for Supervised Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models"
    authors: "Li et al."
    year: 2025
    venue: ICML 2025
    category: data-mixing
    role: background
    key_finding: "SFT mixing as optimization with scaling-law parameterization. Optimal weights depend on model size and data scale."

  - id: seddik2024synthetic_bound

    authors: "Seddik et al."
    year: 2024
    venue: arXiv
    category: data-mixing
    role: background
    key_finding: "Theoretical upper bounds on low-quality data proportion before collapse. Real data proportion must remain high."
    relevance: "Theoretical grounding for hard thresholds in quality mixing. Our empirical 10-25% window is consistent with their predictions."

  # === Category: curriculum / quality threshold ===

  - id: curriculum_robust2024
    title: "Robust Curriculum Learning: from Clean Label Detection to Noisy Label Self-Correction"
    authors: "Various"
    year: 2024
    venue: OpenReview
    category: curriculum
    role: background
    key_finding: "Networks learn simple patterns first, then overfit noisy labels. Loss-based curriculum selection is unstable; errors accumulate multiplicatively."
    relevance: "Explains WHY threshold exists: once noisy proportion exceeds implicit curriculum capacity, errors accumulate. Our 25% may exceed model's capacity."

  - id: wkm2024alfworld
    title: "Agent Planning with World Knowledge Model"
    authors: "Various"
    year: 2024
    venue: NeurIPS 2024
    category: curriculum
    role: evaluation
    key_finding: "World knowledge models reduce hallucinatory actions in ALFWorld. SFT on expert trajectories prone to overfitting."
    relevance: "ALFWorld baseline showing SFT quality sensitivity. Hallucination increase from poor training data parallels our error-injection degradation."

  # === Category: training-dynamics / memorization ===

  - id: arpit2017memorization
    title: "A Closer Look at Memorization in Deep Networks"
    authors: "Arpit, Jastrzębski, Ballas, Krueger, Bengio, Kanwal, Maharaj, Fischer, Courville, Bengio, Lacoste-Julien"
    year: 2017
    venue: ICML 2017
    category: training-dynamics
    role: background
    key_finding: "DNNs first learn clean patterns (early learning phase), then memorize noise. Training loss/accuracy improve on noisy data but generalization degrades. Dataset-independent capacity concepts are insufficient."
    relevance: "Directly explains our '50% injection → lowest train loss but worst eval' paradox. Higher injection = more noisy samples to memorize, better train metrics but worse generalization."

  - id: liu2020early_learning_reg
    title: "Early-Learning Regularization Prevents Memorization of Noisy Labels"
    authors: "Liu, Niles-Weed, Razavian, Fernandez-Granda"
    year: 2020
    venue: NeurIPS 2020
    category: training-dynamics
    role: background
    key_finding: "Formalizes early learning phenomenon: models predict true labels for mislabeled examples early in training, then memorize wrong labels. ELR regularization exploits this window."
    relevance: "Our error-injected samples may be correctly handled early in training but memorized later, degrading clean-data generalization. Explains why more epochs could worsen the gap."

  - id: zhou2023lima
    title: "LIMA: Less Is More for Alignment"
    authors: "Zhou, Liu, Xu, Iyer, Sun, Du, Lin, Geng, Zhang, Patel, Yu, Hinton"
    year: 2023
    venue: NeurIPS 2023
    category: training-dynamics
    role: background
    key_finding: "Superficial Alignment Hypothesis: LLM knowledge/capability comes from pretraining; SFT only teaches output style/format. Limited SFT data suffices."
    relevance: "Explains why lower SFT loss ≠ better downstream capability. Error injection improves surface-level fitting (lower loss) but doesn't enhance—and may damage—pretrained planning capability."

  - id: luo2023catastrophic_forgetting
    title: "An Empirical Study of Catastrophic Forgetting in Large Language Models During Continual Fine-tuning"
    authors: "Luo, Xu, Zheng, Zhao, Yang, Bian, Zheng"
    year: 2023
    venue: arXiv 2308.08747
    category: training-dynamics
    role: background
    key_finding: "SFT is off-policy learning prone to overfit training distribution and forget pretraining knowledge. Forgetting severity increases with divergence between fine-tuning and pretraining distributions."
    relevance: "Error injection increases distributional gap from pretraining data, accelerating catastrophic forgetting. 50% injection → maximal divergence → most forgetting of planning capability."

  - id: longpre2020augmentation
    title: "To Augment or Not to Augment? A Comparative Study on Text Augmentation Techniques for Low-Resource NLP"
    authors: "Longpre, Wang, De Melo"
    year: 2020
    venue: ACL (Computational Linguistics)
    category: training-dynamics
    role: background
    key_finding: "Text augmentation methods assume label-preservation and distribution-stationarity; violations degrade performance. Token-level augmentation surprisingly hurts on complex tasks."
    relevance: "Error injection is non-label-preserving augmentation that shifts distribution. Explains why Random 10% (mild shift, preserves diversity) helps but higher ratios (major shift) hurt."

    year: 2017
    venue: ICML 2017
    category: training-dynamics

    category: training-dynamics
    role: background
